after all: After all means emphasizes something to be considered.
For example: "After all, she is your boss, so invite her."
After all can also mean in spite of expectations.
after hours: After hours means not during regular hours.
For example: "He often worked after hours."
afterward: Afterward means happening at a time subsequent to a reference time.
Afterward means the same as subsequently or later or afterwards.
afterwards: Afterwards means happening at a time subsequent to a reference time.
Afterwards means the same as subsequently or later or afterward.
